spec: 1N4148, through-hole DO-35
notes: 33 left + 34 right (encoder push switch is in the matrix). Cathode toward the row (COL2ROW).

spec: SK6812MINI-E (reverse mount, 3.2×2.8 mm)
india: Not stocked by Indian stores I checked
notes: 33 per-key per half, no underglow (the battery sits under the PCB). The only fiddly SMD part; buy plenty, joints fail. Alternative: JLCPCB assembles them.

spec: 10 µF + 100 nF capacitors, 0805 SMD (C1, C2)

spec: EC11 with push switch, 20 mm shaft

spec: Aluminium knob for 6 mm shaft, ~19 mm diameter
